# Shell commands the skills and routines run, one per entry; entries are separated by a line `----`.
# Each must run with no guard question in a workspace session (tests/test_redteam.py). $W is the workspace path.
"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/mother" path
----
cd $W
----
${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/mother home check
----
mother status
----
